lead: For better or worse, your digital traces are collected by various companies and tools. Combray helps you explore this data, to use it to reflect on your digital life, and to donate it to research if you want to.
explore: Explore: load the data download you got from a platform and look through it, as a timeline, a table or a chart.
reflect: Reflect: answer questions about what you see, on your own or together with a researcher.
share: Share, if you want: you choose exactly what to give to the study. Nothing is sent without your say.
private: Your data stays on your own computer, encrypted. Researchers only see what you choose to share, and the server cannot read it.
participantText: Open the link you received from the researchers. Already started? Continue where you left off.
researcherText: Set up a study, decide what participants see and what they may share, and open donations with your passkey.
